title: The Missing Ring
content:
Emma visited her grandmother on Sunday.

Her grandmother looked worried.

— My ring disappeared! — she said.

Emma looked around the room.

— When did you see it last?

— I saw it yesterday. I put it on the table.

Emma checked the table, but the ring wasn't there.

She looked under the chair. She opened the drawers. She searched the kitchen.

Then she saw something strange.

There were small pieces of dirt near the window.

— Did someone come through the window? — Emma asked.

Her grandmother shook her head.

— No. The window was closed.

Emma thought for a moment.

Then she remembered the family cat.

She followed the cat into the garden.

The cat walked to a small flower pot and stopped.

Emma moved the pot and found the ring under it!

— We found it! — Emma shouted.

Her grandmother laughed.

— My cat took my ring!

Emma smiled.

— It wasn't a thief. It was just a curious cat!

The mystery was solved.
